Sources & scope

Resources

Course sources

  • ECON2103 Fall 2026 lecture slides, Chapters 1–8, 14 and 15, in the learner's Canvas/Lecture Slides folder: primary course-specific definitions, diagrams and scope. Each lesson cites its chapter slide deck.
  • ECON2103 Fall 2026 problem sets, Chapters 1–8, 14 and 15, and self-practice sets in Canvas/Problem Sets: source for worked-problem types and exam-relevant applications. These scanned instructor materials are not redistributed in this public repository.
  • ECON2103 Midterm Bilingual Study Notes.md: assistant-authored synthesis of the above; lesson text derives from this material and is not an official course resource.

Gaps

  • The instructor's final midterm coverage and weighting are not independently established here. Chapter 1's macroeconomic principles are marked not required on the slides; one Chapter 8 extension is marked optional.
  • Existing learning records do not establish mastery. Browser-local quiz data provides practice feedback, not a validated assessment.
